name: CheckIfFileExists
label: Check If File Exists (HTTP)
description: Checks if a workbook exists in OneDrive or SharePoint.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant ID (e.g., your-tenant.onmicrosoft.com or GUID).

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Azure AD application (client) ID registered in your tenant.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret for the Azure AD application. Keep this secure.

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the file in the drive (e.g., 'Reports/Sales.xlsx').

fields.name: Exists
fields.label: File Exists
fields.description: True if the file exists; otherwise, false.
